# JSON for Modern C++

Unmodified single header from nlohmann/json **3.11.3**, under MIT.
`LICENSE.MIT` retains the license; `upstream.json` records source URLs and
SHA-256 hashes. CTest checks both files offline.

MAM uses a SYSTEM include target and `<nlohmann/json.hpp>`. This is a JSON
parser, not a JSON Schema validator. Review a specific upstream version before
replacing files and updating the manifest.
